messages.subject: Bifactor model in SimSem
parts:
Hi all,

I am working through the vingettes for simsem, but looking specifically to simulate a bifactor model. In my case this is 5 specific factors and one general factor. However, does anyone have any very generic code or reprex for this task I could use to understand how to specify these kinds of model correctly in the simsem matrix style input rather than with lavaan syntax?

If not, I will just use lavaan syntax, but simsem syntax is better suited for functioning up to change variables easily.

Thanks!
Pip

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Bifactor model in SimSem
parts: looking specifically to simulate a bifactor model

Just specify the factor loading matrix accordingly.

load.free <- matrix(0, 6, 3) 
load.free[1:6, 1] <- NA # general factor
load.free[1:3, 2] <- NA # specific factors
load.free[4:6, 3] <- NA 

Then repeat but specify population values for the loadings, and bind() them together for your model()
